how: the card's rule as written: 'R0 is tau -> -conj(tau), z -> conj(z). On the flux-6 modes ... it acts as plain complex conjugation K, with no permutation of k'. On main's own mode functions (checks/physical_c8_tick_higgs.py, K9) the reflection z -> conj(z) with tau -> -conj(tau) sends psi_k to the conjugate of psi_(-k): conjugation composed with the parity k -> -k (7e-15), and not plain conjugation (difference 2.24). Plain conjugation belongs to z -> -conj(z), which is what the usual rule z' = conj(z)/(c conj(tau) + d) gives for R0 = diag(1, -1)
